episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: A crime unit with the lowest arrest rate gets started on its first case with its new chief, Yubin.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: The team investigates a murder disguised as a suicide and gets in a bind as another death occurs.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The team advances the investigation with information from the witness. Yubin identifies the suspect.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: A fire breaks out at a fried chicken shop run by Joongryeok's acquaintance.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: The team narrows down the arson suspects but hits a dead end. Yu-bin then proposes a shocking theory.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Following Yu-bin's lead, the team pivots their investigation and uncovers new information.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: A six-year-old girl is kidnapped. Amid the kidnapper's threats, Yu-bin dismisses a prime suspect.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Another team takes over the case, but Yu-bin's team secretly continues probing, sparking a showdown.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Tansik discovers a crucial clue after someone he knows is murdered. Yubin's team investigates and faces danger after sneaking into a restricted area.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Yubin's team gets CCTV footage of the brawler yet lacks proof. As the suspect sets to flee the country, Yubin rushes the evidence to the forensics.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: The Violent Crimes Unit arrests a woman caught in a romance scam and traces her money to one location. They set up a dramatic stakeout.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: After the stakeout, the team baits the suspect on an app and sets up a meeting. However, things are not as they seem.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Yubin's team investigates the theft of the "Chungwoonsansudo" painting from Professor Kim's collection, focusing on those with access to his home.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: Yubin arrests a suspect who reveals that someone else has stolen the painting. The team goes undercover to catch the real culprit.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: The Violent Crimes Unit tackles an illegal gambling case, uncovering the MZ Union. Yubin forms the Dongbang Group to catch the leader.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Yubin's team goes undercover, gaining influence with a flashy social media account. Yubin secures a meeting with the MZ Union's right-hand man.

episodes.title: Episode 17
episodes.summary: The body of a university student is found at Songnae Mountain. Yubin uncovers clues at the scene and the case mirrors the murder of Yubin's fiancee.

episodes.title: Episode 18
episodes.summary: Yubin's friend Hyunwoo identifies the prime suspect and exposes him on television while Junghwan secures crucial CCTV footage but falls into danger.

episodes.title: Episode 19
episodes.summary: Junghwan undergoes surgery but remains unconscious. Joongryeok hunts down the voice phishing gang and finds their hideout.

episodes.title: Episode 20
episodes.summary: Yubin confides to the team that Han Junho is not the real culprit. Despite the lack of solid proof, the team agrees to help Yubin.
